opening.comment: The greeting gave only the company name; the agent's own name was not given.

verification.quote: Agent: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: Verification was done correctly by asking for full name and order number before looking up the order.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi, I sent a return back two weeks ago and I still haven't had my refund.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue, the missing refund for a return, without asking for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy states the refund is paid within 5 working days of the return reaching the warehouse, and the item arrived 3 working days ago, so the agent's timeline was wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/label step applied, and the call involved no bank dispute, so no required steps were missed; the wrong timeline is covered under resolution accuracy.

communication.quote: Agent: I understand, it's worrying when money is outstanding.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's worry about the outstanding refund.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day it's paid. Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: The agent explained the next step and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely.
